name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
summary: A one-off grant from the Dutch Ministry of Education and participating universities for students from outside the European Economic Area (EEA).
value: €5,000, paid once in the first year of study
eligibility: Applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating institution
Not previously studied in the Netherlands
caveats: This is NOT a full scholarship: €5,000 is a one-time amount and does not renew.
It does not cover tuition on its own; you still need to fund the rest of tuition and all living costs.
You apply directly to the university, not to a paid agency. Application is free.

name: Orange Knowledge Programme (ended)
summary: A former Dutch government scholarship for professionals from eligible countries. It has ended and has no new application rounds.
caveats: The Orange Knowledge Programme ended in 2024. There are no new rounds.
If an agency offers to get you an 'Orange Knowledge' scholarship, that is a red flag - the programme is closed.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
summary: EU-funded scholarships for selected joint master's programmes studied across multiple European countries, often including the Netherlands.
value: Typically covers tuition plus a monthly living allowance and travel; amount varies by programme
eligibility: Admission to a specific Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters programme
Selection is highly competitive and programme-specific
caveats: You apply to the specific joint programme, not to a general fund.
Highly competitive; funding is limited and merit-based.
